title: AMD Radeon RX 6800 with Ray Tracing ON / OFF Benchmarks
description:
Ray Tracing is here on AMD Radeon RX 6000 series graphics card and I'm here to tell you my experience with it.

While the technology is nothing new it's good to see that AMD card now has it, as with newly introduced technology to a system we'll have to wait for it to develop.

1:41 - Shadow of the Tomb Raider Comparison
2:16 - The Riftbreaker Comparison
3:01 - Godfall Comparison
3:31 - Benchmark and Performance Impact Analysis
3:50 - My take on AMD and Ray Tracing
